(670 minutes) |discs= |cassettes= |pages= |isbn=9798217290383 |timeline=[[33 BBY/Legends|32.5 BBY]]While ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' places ''Cloak of Deception'' in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the [[2000]] establishes a gap of at least six months between ''Cloak of Deception'' and ''The Phantom Menace'', which puts it in 32.5 BBY per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' and ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''. |series= |preceded by= |followed by= }} '''''Cloak of Deception''''' is the unabridged audio version of the [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]] novel [[Cloak of Deception|of the same name]], by author [[James Luceno]]. The audiobook was narrated by [[Jonathan Davis]] and released by [[Random House Audio]] on [[August 11]], [[2026]] as part of ''[[The Essential Legends Collection]]''.
